title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity bumps (v1.79.0)
author: Elaine Park
release_notes: SDKs: unify auth provider behavior, standardize retry/backoff across Python/TS/Go, ensure streaming API parity, bump SDK versions to v1.79.0. Migration notes included for token provider and retry config defaults.
description: Unify SDK behavior across Python, TypeScript, and Go for auth, retries, and streaming ergonomics and bump releases to v1.79.0. Motivation: multiple downstream customers and internal teams observed subtle differences in retry/backoff semantics and streaming reconnection behavior between language SDKs which caused inconsistent app behavior and debugging complexity. This PR centralizes the token provider interface, normalizes default retry/backoff settings (exponential backoff with jitter, configurable max elapsed), and aligns streaming APIs surface (on_open/on_message/on_close callbacks and consistent reconnect/backoff behavior). Changes also include ergonomics improvements (type hints, clearer error classes, consistent naming), small docs and migration guide, CI additions (integration smoke for streaming), and version bumps for each SDK package. Checklist: 1) Consolidated token provider adapter and updated constructors; 2) Implemented unified RetryPolicy and applied to HTTP client + streaming transport; 3) Streaming: added explicit reconnect loop with max_attempts and jittered backoff; 4) Added integration tests for streaming reconnect and retryable 5xx flows; 5) Updated CHANGELOGs and release artifacts; 6) Manual smoke tested Python/TS/Go examples. Summary of commits and rationale included below.
commits: feat(sdk-common): add TokenProvider interface + adapters for python/ts/go
feat(retries): introduce RetryPolicy with exponential backoff + jitter; wire into http client and streaming transport
fix(streaming): consistent reconnect loop and event callbacks across SDKs; handle partial payloads on reconnect
chore(release): bump python/ts/go SDKs to v1.79.0; update changelogs
test(integration): add streaming reconnect + retry integration smoke tests
docs: migration guide for auth provider and retry defaults
